<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Landscaping&nbsp;
(Implementation)</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried
out in accordance with the approved details as shown: Proposed Site Plan rev P2;&nbsp;</span></span>ART_GRA_203_S4_p1; ART_GRA_SK02.6_S4_01.<span style="line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp;The works shall be carried out in the first available
planting season following the completion of the development or prior to the
occupation of any part of the development, whichever is the sooner, and any
border planting which dies within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development,
are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased or are dying, shall&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">be replaced in the
next planting season with others of same approved specification, unless the
Local Planning Authority gives written consent to any variation. All hard
surfacing and means of enclosure shall be completed before the development is
first occupied.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:" arial",sans-serif;="" mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:="" en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"=""></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; </span></span><span style="font-size: 14px;">To enhance
the appearance of the development in the interest of the amenities of the area,
to ensure the provision sustainable drainage surfaces and to comply with the
following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies G7 and D8 of the
London Plan 2021 and policies F15.7, F15.8, O15.1, O15.2 </span><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">and O15.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p>

External Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

﻿Obscured Glazing - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the rear windows in the first floor rear window of the first floor rear extension elevation shall be glazed with obscured glass and be of restricted opening as to not overlook no.131 Arthur Road and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
